count_all_trainable_weights: count all trainable variables in the default TensorFlow graph and return the total parameter count
count_weights_in_scope: count trainable weights restricted to a specific variable scope like policy or actor
count_weights_with_exclude: count trainable weights while excluding variables matching a regex pattern from the total
count_weights_on_graph: count trainable weights on a specific TensorFlow graph instead of the default graph
review_count_weights_function: review the count_weights function to understand how it filters and sums trainable variable shapes
